before.vi: Snapshot trước event theo đặc tả B8; chưa phải runtime capture.
before.en: Pre-event snapshot from the B8 specification; not a runtime capture.

delta.vi: Pipeline Read→Sort→Output dùng state v0→v1→v2: mỗi call chỉ mở khi producer trước hoàn tất và Output nhận đúng v2.
delta.en: A Read→Sort→Output pipeline uses state v0→v1→v2: each call unlocks only after its producer completes, and Output receives v2.

after.vi: Trạng thái đích theo invariant; Stage 7 sẽ triển khai replay.
after.en: Target state under the invariant; Stage 7 will implement replay.

invariant.vi: After each orchestration event, every completed call has received the source-required arguments, its result/state version is owned once, and every pending call still has a satisfiable precondition.
invariant.en: After each orchestration event, every completed call has received the source-required arguments, its result/state version is owned once, and every pending call still has a satisfiable precondition.

prediction.vi: Dự đoán event kế tiếp và state nào phải được giữ nguyên.
prediction.en: Predict the next event and which state must remain unchanged.

feedback.vi: Đối chiếu event, bất biến và output; nếu sai dùng Reset rồi replay.
feedback.en: Compare event, invariant and output; if wrong, use Reset and replay.

replay_semantics.vi: Play chạy tuần tự; Previous/Next đi qua đúng event; replay giữ nguyên input.
replay_semantics.en: Play runs events in order; Previous/Next selects exact events; replay keeps the same input.

reset_semantics.vi: Reset về snapshot đặc tả; change_input chỉ dùng fixture Stage 5 đã khóa.
reset_semantics.en: Reset returns to the specified snapshot; change_input uses only locked Stage 5 fixtures.

static_fallback.vi: Bảng before/delta/after cùng guard và invariant.
static_fallback.en: Before/delta/after table with guard and invariant.
